doc: TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE §12.8/§12.9 — the data desk of Nebenstelle Süd (round 13, owner: terminal). Optional content of L_C4_Annex scene D (Story scene L_C4_AnnexB, level key L_C4_AnnexA like every find of the level file; `scene` names the walk area, read by the tests and the memory cards). Side task „Planspiel Abgang“ (Konrad): the data desk asks for an operator number (exp_terminal, 1096) -> the duty roster of the Datenstelle on its clipboard beside the second ladder (exp_terminal_roster, 1326) -> back at the desk the mini-game „Die Datenstelle“ (scenes/ui/minigames/DataTerminal.tscn: login, list / open / search over five files, the release of the locked program by the case number two files give together) -> the mini-game „Planspiel Abgang“ (scenes/ui/minigames/PlanspielAbgang.tscn: the State Police's arrest simulation as a wireframe 3D game, three maps). The spots are not nodes of the level file: the actor scenes/levels/c4/AnnexTerminal.tscn (scene.json "actors", scripts/levels/c4/annex_terminal.gd) carries the desk's art and both lever_spot.gd interactables (chain on the desk: term_desk -> term_files -> planspiel). Texts: data/locale/de_terminal.json / en_terminal.json; art and layout: tools/pixelgen/gen_annex_terminal.py; sounds: tools/audiogen/mg_audio_terminal.py; tests: tests/test_c4_terminal.gd. No Story state, no new flags.
